name: @cookhouse/api-contract
description: Published AppRouter type from cookhouse-api. Types only — no runtime code, no Prisma, no server dependencies ship in this package. Lets cookhouse-webplatform (and a future mobile client) keep tRPC's end-to-end type inference once the backend and frontend are separate repos, without either depending on the other's source.

scripts.prepublishOnly: test -f dist/router.d.ts || (echo 'dist/router.d.ts missing — run pnpm build:contract from cookhouse-api first' && exit 1)
